rows.rationale: Follows read-form plunder; retains accumulating threats.
rows.before: so, look, I have stretched out my hand against you and will give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and make you perish from the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"
rows.after: So I have stretched out my hand against you. I will give you as plunder to the nations, cut you off from the peoples, and make you disappear from the lands. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
rows.tsw_comparator: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand against you and will give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and make you perish from the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"

rows.rationale: Retains repeated court and transferable holiness concept.

rows.after: When they go out to the outer court—to the outer court where the people are—they must remove their service garments and leave them in the holy chambers. They must put on other clothes, so they do not transmit holiness to the people through their garments.
rows.tsw_comparator: When they go out to the outer court, to the outer court where the people are, they shall take off the garments in which they minister and leave them in the holy chambers. They shall put on other garments, so that they do not communicate holiness to the people by their garments.
